title: D-TINs for Track-Sampled Ice Sheet Surface Reconstruction from Satellite Altimetry Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.12894v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Satellite altimetry samples ice sheets densely along tracks but sparsely across tracks, with frequent gaps in spatial coverage. We study the impact of this irregular support on surface reconstruction and introduce a new method, D-TIN, that applies Delaunay triangulation and barycentric interpolation directly to observed locations. A spatial holdout removes contiguous track intervals and nearby same-pass observations. We compare D-TIN with two common workflows, kriging and tile-based polynomial interpolation, to evaluate its accuracy and computational efficiency. Across seven ICESat-1 campaigns, D-TIN reduces RMSE by 12.1 m to 23.6 m relative to independent 5 km tile and polynomial based reconstruction. Its aggregate accuracy is close to the ordinary kriging workflow using a 1 km grid on the commonly used GStatSim platform while its median runtime is 252 times lower. translated_title: 基于卫星测高数据轨迹采样的冰盖表面重建的D-TIN方法
translated_abstract: 卫星测高沿轨迹对冰盖进行密集采样，但在轨迹之间采样稀疏，空间覆盖中经常存在缺口。我们研究了这种不规则采样分布对表面重建的影响，并提出了一种新方法D-TIN，该方法将Delaunay三角剖分和重心插值直接应用于观测位置。通过空间保留集（spatial holdout）移除了连续的轨迹区间以及同一次经过的邻近观测。我们将D-TIN与两种常见工作流程——克里金法和基于瓦片的多项式插值——进行比较，以评估其精度和计算效率。在七个ICESat-1观测活动中，相对于独立的基于5公里瓦片和多项式的重建，D-TIN将RMSE降低了12.1米至23.6米。其总体精度接近于在常用的GStatSim平台上使用1公里网格的普通克里金工作流程，而其中位数运行时间则降低了252倍。D-TIN的固定权重多尺度扩展版本，称为MS-D-TIN，提供了……
tldr: 本文提出D-TIN方法，直接对卫星测高观测点进行Delaunay三角剖分和重心插值以重建冰盖表面，在精度接近克里金法的同时将运行时间降低了252倍。
en_tdlr: D-TIN applies Delaunay triangulation and barycentric interpolation directly to track-sampled satellite altimetry observations for ice sheet surface reconstruction, achieving accuracy comparable to kriging while reducing runtime by 252 times.
